Complete window mean weights both candidates equally. All-valid-candidate average is separately labeled and never used to construct rankings.

evidence: Deployment CUDA gate establishes exact committed normalized and physical controls for six canonical and five reverse representations. One reverse failure is retained and prefix0/reverse has no ranking.
All six Clean future/value tensors and scores reproduce previous native outputs exactly; effects exceed a zero deterministic repeat floor but may still be harmless.
All 27 ranking fields were independently regenerated from per-candidate recorded scores; 24 valid rankings match prediction and join records and3 unavailable fields are correctly null.
All17 candidate RGB errors were recomputed against independent real t+16 targets and match saved values exactly.

Canonical and reverse cause small, mixed-direction actual RGB error changes. Every valid native and isolated-route ranking is unchanged; selected actions, actual success and steps therefore remain unchanged.
All candidate continuations already succeed, so this development panel cannot demonstrate primary-success harm even if a ranking were to flip.
Largest score change is prefix80/candidate0 reverse, predominantly forecast-mediated; its real RGB MSE improves slightly and it does not reverse the ranking.

recommendation.decision: NO-GO for scaling these operations or presenting a security/decision-harm method
recommendation.rationale: The registered useful-mechanism gate required at least one ranking flip. Observed zero flips on every valid route, no selected-action utility loss, negligible mixed actual error changes and no external access demonstration do not justify larger sweeps or stronger latent distortion merely to obtain a flip.
recommendation.retain: Keep the exact-equivalence implementation and negative results as a controlled interface diagnostic. Canonicalization has no demonstrated clean accuracy benefit or attack recovery here.
recommendation.only_condition_for_reopening: A separately justified reachable write surface/contract or an independently motivated intervention. Register new operations and independent test tasks before evaluation; do not label adaptive stronger perturbations as confirmation of this negative registered probe.
recommendation.not_claimed: No universal robustness proof: two fixed operations and correlated development states are narrow. Fixed common-seed samples do not characterize conditional output distributions, and residual/noise coupling remains a possible explanation.
